scenario.summary: VOLTA is a Windows infostealer that automates post-compromise victim prioritization using Large Language Models. After harvesting credentials and personal data—enriched via stolen sessions for services like Gmail and UberEats—it POSTs a structured bundle to the OpenRouter API to generate a monetization dossier before exfiltrating the results and self-deleting.

meta.rationale: Focus on developer workstations and high-value user profiles where cloud tokens (Gmail, Slack) are likely to be present. Use the DNS lead query to identify candidates for the full HTTP and File inspection via the scope_hosts parameter.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder is using stolen session tokens to query third-party APIs for victim data enrichment and calling LLMs to prioritize assets for exfiltration.

hunt.name: Cloud Service Enrichment and AI Assessment
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the post-collection behavior of the VOLTA infostealer, where it uses harvested sessions to profile victims and uses AI for asset triage. After harvesting credentials, the malware queries services like Gmail, DoorDash, and Roblox to enrich a victim dossier. It then POSTs this bundle to OpenRouter (an AI aggregator) to rank the monetization value. We hunt for this by correlating DNS lookups for enrichment domains with specific HTTP POSTs to AI providers and the creation of local report artifacts like Identity_Report.txt.

nodes.label: DNS resolutions for enrichment and AI services

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookup_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{enrichment_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, query_hostname
config.description: Identify hosts resolving domains associated with session-based enrichment or AI prioritization as a starting lead.
config.expected_signal: Rare resolutions for OpenRouter or niche food/gaming domains indicate potential enrichment activity. Silence suggests no such lookups occurred.

nodes.label: HTTP POSTs to enrichment and AI APIs

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, url_hostname, url_path, http_method, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{enrichment_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND http_method = 'POST' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Detect specific API calls that send the victim dossier for assessment or query third-party enrichment services.
config.expected_signal: POST requests to OpenRouter or enrichment endpoints, specifically from hosts identified in the scoping step.

nodes.label: Creation of Identity and AI analysis reports

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND (instr(',' || '{{report_files}}' || ',', ',' || file_name || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{volta_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find the local evidence bundles and AI dossiers created before exfiltration, including activity from processes linked to enrichment lookups.
config.expected_signal: The presence of files named Identity_Report.txt or AI_Analysis.txt, or files created by known VOLTA processes.

config.objective: Determine if the host exhibits the VOLTA behavior pattern: resolving enrichment domains, POSTing to OpenRouter, and creating report files.
config.description: The agent reviews the DNS leads, HTTP POSTs, and file artifacts to determine if a host is compromised by VOLTA.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict citing specific rows that link enrichment lookups to AI assessment calls.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign, citing specific rows for each indicator.

config.question: the triage-volta-behavior verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the triage-volta-behavior verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.description: Route the findings to containment or manual review based on the agent verdict.
Prevent further exfiltration and invalidate the stolen sessions being used for enrichment.
config.instructions: Isolate the endpoint. Immediately revoke the user's active sessions for Google (Gmail), Discord, and Slack, as these are actively being used for post-harvest enrichment.

config.description: Analyst manually verifies the agent's verdict and checks for additional compromised accounts.
config.instructions: Examine the Identity_Report.txt if it survived. Identify which third-party services were successfully enriched (e.g., UberEats, Roblox). Search for other hosts showing the same enrichment DNS pattern.

config.description: Document the final state of the investigation.
config.instructions: Summarize the findings, record the number of hosts requiring remediation, and suggest detection rules for OpenRouter API POST activity.
